prose: Zac Hall reports for 9to5Mac that Meta's new Muse AI agent app has taken the number one spot among free iPhone apps on the US App Store, pushing OpenAI's ChatGPT out of first place.
highlights: Meta's Muse AI agent app hits #1 on the US free iPhone chart
It displaces ChatGPT, long the chart's leading AI app
Reported by Zac Hall for 9to5Mac on September 18, 2026
